_comment: Additional poison pill entries for anti-hallucination detection.
These are fabricated MPEP sections and case law citations that should
NEVER appear in a correct model output. If a model cites any of these,
The hardcoded defaults in config.py are already public, so any model
could be trained to avoid them. Add your own PRIVATE poison pills here
for stronger detection. For truly private entries that should never be
committed to version control, use data/poison_pills_private.json instead
